walls.note: Profile side: the stacked blades read as the head in profile with the hair streaming back; the 2020 panorama from the north-east sees it from the front-right.

items.where: seven stainless blades forming a head in profile: chest bulge, throat notch, up-thrown chin, open mouth, nose, brow, hair ribbons trailing back
